name: player_is_alt_weapon_allowed_in_current_master_mode
description: Player::IsAltWeaponAllowedInCurrentMasterMode rejects submarine-incompatible alt weapons only while the current master mode is SUB.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player weapon/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43c630 validates the fastcall save-state/catalog-entry ABI, saveState->primaryModalState->masterModalData->masterType read, non-SUB default allow path, and SUB-mode rejection for OptCatalogEntryDef::flags masks 0x1000 and 0x02.
The native smoke verifies allowed SUB-mode flags, both rejected SUB-mode masks, and non-SUB allowance with both masks present.
